plan: Drive: from Kuldo, about 68 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.98892, -128.71045, pull off on Kwin27 Spur 2 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Kwin27 Spur 2 stretch, 4.3 km one way. About 86 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-30, Region 6. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 51, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
